metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for Rust, ESP32 C++, Python backend, .NET backend, SwiftUI, dead code detection, backend validation, mobile validation, Electron validation, macOS app validation, and FFI/UDS seam probing

plugins.name: rust
plugins.description: Rust code critique, architecture guidance, and idiomatic pattern enforcement

plugins.name: esp32-cpp
plugins.description: ESP32 firmware review covering FreeRTOS, memory, peripherals, and all chip variants

plugins.name: python-backend
plugins.description: Python backend architecture for Litestar and FastAPI with SQLAlchemy and SOLID patterns

plugins.name: dotnet-backend
plugins.description: Pure .NET 10 backend architecture for Kestrel-hosted REST and SignalR services with DI, data access, and SOLID review

plugins.name: swiftui
plugins.description: SwiftUI patterns and critique for iOS, macOS, and visionOS apps

plugins.name: dead-code
plugins.description: Find and remove dead code, duplicates, split-brain implementations, and dead deployment artifacts across any language and stack

plugins.name: backend-validator
plugins.description: Backend API and WebSocket validation via Hurl, websocat, and oauth2c with OIDC token caching

plugins.name: maestro-mobile-validator
plugins.description: iOS and Android mobile app validation via Maestro flows with simulator management and CI patterns

plugins.name: electron-playwright-validator
plugins.description: Electron app UI automation and validation via Playwright CDP

plugins.name: peekaboo-macos-validator
plugins.description: macOS app UI automation and visual critique via Peekaboo (no AI keys; agent reads pixels itself)

plugins.name: seam-probe
plugins.description: Generic NDJSON probe for embedded-runtime seams: dlopen FFI dylibs and Unix-domain sockets. Manifest-driven, ships zero app-specific knowledge.

plugins.name: claude-mastery
plugins.description: Master guide for building with Claude Code — battle-tested patterns for agent design, skills, prompt caching, tool design, verification, workflows, and team patterns.
